# Test corpus

Everything here is either generated by this project or in the public domain. No copyrighted material is committed. Private manuscripts used for local testing live in `local/` at the repository root, which git ignores.

## docx/

Regenerate with `python scripts/make_fixtures.py`. A test checks that the committed synthetic files match their generators.

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `styled.docx` | Named styles throughout: Title, Heading 1 and 2, a style based on Heading 1, Quote and Block Text, character styles, inline formatting, a hyperlink, an image with alt text, an empty spacing paragraph |
| `direct.docx` | No styles at all: chapters marked only by bold, size, centring, and page breaks, with italic subtitles |
| `footnotes.docx` | Footnotes (including a multi-paragraph note and a custom `*` mark) and an endnote |
| `tracked.docx` | Insertions, deletions, a move, a formatting change, a deleted paragraph mark, and comments |
| `scene_breaks.docx` | Every scene-break form (typed markers, ornament image, Word horizontal rule, bottom border, underscore line, empty paragraphs) and literal HTML tags |
| `front_back.docx` | Title page, copyright page, dedication, a contents list built from a TOC field, prologue, epilogue, acknowledgements, about the author, a page-number field, and hidden text |
| `persuasion-lo.docx` | A whole novel: Jane Austen's *Persuasion* (1818), built from the text below with a typed contents list and direct-formatting chapter headings, then saved by LibreOffice so the XML is LibreOffice's, not ours |

## pdf/

Generated by `scripts/make_fixtures.py` from DOCX built from the *Persuasion* text, through LibreOffice (with the en-GB hyphenation dictionary installed).

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `clean.pdf` | Three chapters, justified with first-line indents, italics, a centred scene break, paragraphs crossing pages, and a PDF outline |
| `clean-nobookmarks.pdf` | The same without an outline, so chapters must be found from the printed headings |
| `scanned.pdf` | Two pages rendered to images with no text, as a scanner produces |
| `headers.pdf` | Alternating running heads (book title on left pages, chapter title on right) and page numbers |
| `hyphenation.pdf` | A small page set justified with automatic hyphenation (en-GB patterns): dozens of broken words, including real compounds |
| `dropcaps.pdf` | No outline; chapter titles in large type; each chapter opening with a three-line drop cap, one of them an opening quotation mark |
| `footnotes.pdf` | Four footnotes below a separator rule, linked by raised markers, one on a paragraph that continues onto the next page |
| `printed-toc.pdf` | No outline and descriptive chapter titles: chapters can only be found from the printed contents page |

## gutenberg/

`persuasion.txt` is the text of *Persuasion* by Jane Austen (died 1817), from Project Gutenberg eBook #105. It is in the public domain worldwide. The Project Gutenberg header, footer, and licence have been removed, as their terms require for redistributed derivative copies; this file is not a Project Gutenberg edition.
